# Title styles

6 title presets for `add_text` (`preset`) and `add_beat_text`. A preset sets the font, colors, outline, glow and animations, and sizes the text for the frame; the call's own `style` and animations go on top.

```json
{ "text": "UNSTOPPABLE", "start": 11, "duration": 2.7, "preset": "neon", "style": { "outlineColor": "#00E5FF" } }
```

| id | Name | Font | Size (of the short side) | Colors (text / outline / glow) | In / out | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `neon` | Neon | Anton | 11% | #FFFFFF / #FF2E93 / #FF2E93AA | blur / fade | Tall condensed capitals in white with a hot pink outline and a soft pink glow, spaced wide. Night scenes, dance and music videos, club and city footage. |
| `impact` | Impact | Archivo Black | 10% | #FFFFFF / #000000 / none | drop / zoom | Heavy black-letter capitals in white with a thick black outline, slammed in from above. Hype moments, drops, sports, reaction videos; reads on any picture. |
| `glitch` | Glitch | Anton | 10% | #FFFFFF / #00E5FF / #FF00AACC | stretch / fade | Condensed capitals in white with a cyan outline and a magenta shadow offset like a split signal, stretched in. Tech, gaming, electronic music, fast edits. |
| `clean` | Clean | Arimo | 7% | #FFFFFF / none / #00000099 | slide-up / fade | Plain bold sans in white with a light shadow, sliding up gently. Lifestyle, travel, tutorials and calm openers; quiet next to busy footage. |
| `label` | Label | Arimo | 6% | #111111 / none / none | pop / fade | Bold dark text on a white box, popping in. Callouts, names, prices and lists: always readable, looks like a sticker. |
| `cinematic` | Cinematic | Gelasio | 7% | #F4EDE4 / none / #00000080 | fade / fade | Serif capitals in warm white, widely spaced, fading in slowly. Trailers, travel films, weddings and moody openers. |
